record_type_quote: Burton et al. (1998) have proposed a scale to measure consumers’ attitudes toward private labels (ATPL). Their scale, based on previous research in the U.S., does not appear to have been widely tested. This study tests the applicability of the ATPL scale within a German retailing context.
